name: gambling-harm-data
title: Gambling Harm Open Data
description:
Five machine-readable datasets on gambling harm and gambling recovery in the United States, published together and refreshed on a stated clock.

The set covers what each U.S. state publishes about gambling harm and the one comparable 51-jurisdiction helpline series that exists; the responsible-gambling tools each major U.S. sportsbook publishes; a sourced glossary of gambling-recovery and gambling-industry terminology with stigma-preferred phrasing; a dated panel of quit-gambling apps on the U.S. iOS App Store; and a directory of state and multi-state self-exclusion programs.

Every value carries the source it came from or an explicit marker saying why it does not. Nothing here is estimated, modelled, imputed or interpolated. There is no composite score, and states are never ranked on figures that are not comparable.

Produced by Betttr LLC, maker of a recovery app; no operator or affiliate money.

sources.title: National Council on Problem Gambling, National Problem Gambling Helpline annual report, Appendix A (prepared by the Omni Institute)
State gaming regulators, lotteries, behavioral-health agencies and state problem-gambling councils (per-row URLs in state_source_url)
Operator-published responsible-gambling and help-centre pages (per-cell URLs in the *_source columns)
Apple iTunes Search API, U.S. iOS App Store

resources.name: gambling-harm-index
resources.title: Gambling Harm Index
resources.description:
What every U.S. state and the District of Columbia publishes about gambling harm, pooled into one table, plus the one genuinely comparable 51-jurisdiction series that exists: NCPG's annual helpline contact volume and rate per 100,000 residents. One row per jurisdiction. The state-published layer is deliberately NOT comparable across states and is never ranked; the helpline layer is. 'N/A' never means zero harm and never means we did not look.

Rows: 51. Refresh cadence: monthly.

fields.name: state
fields.title: Jurisdiction
fields.description: Name of the U.S. state or the District of Columbia. 51 rows, one per jurisdiction.

fields.name: state_code
fields.title: USPS code
fields.description: Two-letter USPS abbreviation. 'DC' for the District of Columbia.

fields.name: helpline_contacts_2025
fields.title: Helpline contacts, CY2025
fields.description: Total contacts (calls, texts and chats) to the jurisdiction's problem-gambling helpline in calendar year 2025, as published in NCPG's annual helpline report (Appendix A), prepared by the Omni Institute. Unit: contacts. Comparable across states.

fields.name: helpline_contacts_2024
fields.title: Helpline contacts, CY2024
fields.description: Same measure for calendar year 2024. Unit: contacts. Comparable across states.

fields.name: helpline_rate_per_100k_2025
fields.title: Helpline rate per 100k, CY2025
fields.description: CY2025 contacts per 100,000 residents, taken verbatim from NCPG's published rate rather than recomputed, so this file and NCPG always agree. Unit: contacts per 100,000 residents.

fields.name: helpline_rate_per_100k_2024
fields.title: Helpline rate per 100k, CY2024
fields.description: Same measure for CY2024. Unit: contacts per 100,000 residents.

fields.name: helpline_yoy_change
fields.title: Year-over-year change
fields.description: NCPG's own Poisson significance test on the 2024 to 2025 change, reproduced verbatim. Typical values: 'increase, p<.001', 'decrease, p<.001', 'no significant change'. Not recomputed by Betttr.

fields.name: state_funds_pg_services_fy2025
fields.title: Dedicated public funding, FY2025
fields.description: Whether the jurisdiction had dedicated public funding for problem-gambling services in fiscal year 2025.

fields.name: publication_tier
fields.title: Publication tier
fields.description: Betttr's four-way classification of what the jurisdiction publishes about gambling harm. A = publishes a recurring, dated count. B = publishes something stale or partial. C = publishes nothing we could find after checking the behavioral-health agency, the gaming regulator or lottery, and the state council. U = a series is believed to exist but could not be retrieved (blocked fetch, image-only, or viewer with no text layer).

fields.name: state_published_indicator
fields.title: State-published indicator
fields.description: What the jurisdiction itself publishes, in its own terms, e.g. 'Self-exclusion enrollments', 'Helpline calls', 'Treatment admissions', or 'None published'.

fields.name: state_published_latest_value
fields.title: Latest state-published value
fields.description: The most recent value the jurisdiction published for that indicator, as a string because the file carries four distinct non-numeric markers alongside real numbers: 'N/A - state publishes nothing', 'not extracted', 'not published in readable form', and 'not comparable'. None of these means zero. Values in this column are NOT comparable across jurisdictions and are never ranked.

fields.name: state_published_latest_period
fields.title: Period covered
fields.description: The exact period the value covers, as the publisher states it, e.g. 'CY2025', 'FY2026', 'as of 9/2/2026'. 'unknown' where the publisher gives no period. No value appears in this file without a period.

fields.name: state_publisher
fields.title: Publishing body
fields.description: The agency, regulator, lottery or council that published the value.

fields.name: state_source_url
fields.title: Source URL
fields.description: URL of the source document or page for the state-published value. 'N/A' where nothing is published.

fields.name: machine_readable
fields.title: Machine-readable at source
fields.description: Whether the jurisdiction publishes this indicator in a machine-readable format (CSV, JSON, API, or an extractable HTML table) as opposed to a PDF, image or viewer.

fields.name: notes
fields.title: Notes
fields.description: Free text: what was checked, what was blocked, scope caveats, and why a marker was used.

resources.name: sportsbook-rg-tools
resources.title: Sportsbook Responsible-Gambling Tool Matrix
resources.description:
Which responsible-gambling tools each major U.S. sportsbook, daily-fantasy and prediction operator publishes: deposit, loss, wager and time limits, cool-off, in-product self-exclusion, whether a written self-exclusion request is accepted, the account-closure path, and the documented navigation to reach any of it. Every claim carries the operator-published URL it came from. Where an operator documents a mechanic but not its parameters, the cell says 'not published' rather than guessing, and that absence is itself the finding.

Rows: 14. Refresh cadence: quarterly.

resources.name: recovery-glossary
resources.title: Gambling Recovery Glossary
resources.description:
125 gambling-recovery and gambling-industry terms with a plain-English definition, a stigma-preferred phrasing note, and a source or an explicit unsourced marker. Four sections: recovery language, industry and product terms, regulators and clinical instruments, and stigma-preferred language pairs. Intended for journalists, clinicians and researchers who need one defensible definition of a term like 'chasing losses' or 'self-exclusion' and a defensible way to write about the people affected.

Rows: 125. Refresh cadence: as needed; reviewed quarterly.

fields.name: term
fields.title: Term
fields.description: The glossary term, or the discouraged term where the row is a stigma-preferred language pair (section D).

fields.name: preferred_term
fields.title: Preferred term
fields.description: For section D rows only: the phrasing to use instead. Empty for sections A-C.

fields.name: section_letter
fields.title: Section letter
fields.description: A = recovery language (39 terms). B = industry and product terms (41). C = regulators, programs and clinical instruments (23). D = stigma-preferred language pairs (22).

fields.name: section
fields.title: Section name
fields.description: Human-readable name of the section.

fields.name: definition
fields.title: Definition
fields.description: Plain-English definition written at roughly an 8th-grade reading level. Markdown emphasis has been stripped; internal quotation marks are preserved.

fields.name: preferred_phrasing_note
fields.title: Preferred phrasing note
fields.description: Guidance on what to say and what to avoid. 'safe to use as written' where the term carries no stigma. Empty where the source entry has no such line.

fields.name: source_url
fields.title: Source URL
fields.description: First authoritative URL cited for the entry. Empty where the entry is unsourced.

fields.name: source_note
fields.title: Source note
fields.description: The non-URL remainder of the source line, including the '[UNSOURCED - ...]' marker and its reason where present.

fields.name: source_status
fields.title: Source status
fields.description: sourced = an authoritative URL supports the definition. partial = a source supports the harm framing or the figures but not the mechanical definition. unsourced = no authoritative definitional source was located; the definition reflects consistent common usage and says so. 'n/a - language pair' = section D rows, which are editorial guidance rather than defined terms.

fields.name: term_slug
fields.title: URL slug
fields.description: Lowercase hyphenated slug, stable across releases, matching the per-term URL at https://betttr.net/glossary/<slug>/.

resources.name: quit-gambling-apps
resources.title: Quit-Gambling App Panel
resources.description:
A dated panel of apps surfaced on the U.S. iOS App Store by three seed searches: 'quit gambling', 'gambling blocker' and 'gambling addiction recovery'. 107 unique apps, of which 63 are gambling-specific harm-reduction tools after hand review. Carries release and update dates, rating counts, Apple genres and a hand-assigned classification. This is a panel of what those three searches surface, NOT a census of the store, because the Apple search endpoint returns at most 50 results per term. Treat all counts as a floor. Betttr's own app is in this panel, counted the same way as every other app, with no adjustment.

Rows: 107. Refresh cadence: monthly.

resources.name: self-exclusion-programs
resources.title: State and Multi-State Self-Exclusion Programs
resources.description:
How to enroll in self-exclusion, by jurisdiction: the administering body, the enrollment method, the direct program URL and the scope of what the exclusion covers, plus one row for the multi-state National Voluntary Self-Exclusion Program and the states it reaches. This file is NOT yet a 50-state census; it covers the jurisdictions verified for the Betttr self-exclusion directory and is being extended toward full coverage. Absence of a state is absence of verification, not absence of a program.

Rows: 12. Refresh cadence: quarterly.
